plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Fragrant, rounded-petalled blossoms burst straight from bare branches while snow can still linger on the ground. Their sweet scent and early courage have made them a beloved symbol of resilience in Japanese art and poetry.
plants.bloomingSeason: January to February, ahead of cherry blossoms in March
plants.location: Japan, native to the Yangtze River region of China
plants.funFact: Ume blossoms sit directly on the branch without stalks, while cherry blossoms hang on long stems and have notched petals. This is the easiest way to tell the two apart.
